verdict.rationale: Airbyte OSS core is well documented as self-hostable via Docker/abctl or Kubernetes (docs-12,13,16,28,31,37,45), and one community user confirms running it self-hosted in production (airbyte-comm-7). However, hands-on community reports describe a self-hosting failure ('Even a simple installation of airbyte on my local machine fails... docker-compose up!' — airbyte-comm-1) and dispute the 'open source' framing, claiming security-relevant features are gated behind payment (airbyte-comm-2), directly contradicting a clean self-host story. missing for 10: independent verification that installation reliably works out-of-the-box, clarity on which security/enterprise features are excluded from the self-hosted core.
